incident: Canonical obligation cockpit and metrics existed only as service-role Supabase views, so the operator could not inspect requested goal, state, evidence, blockers, next automatic action and actual result from the Portal UI.
root_cause: Backend projection was completed before a secure internal consumer surface was connected.
prevention_rule: Operational control-plane UI must consume only canonical projection views through an authenticated internal boundary. System-wide obligation truth must never be exposed through tenant-only authorization.
